❤️ Join me to share my love and excitement in getting abandoned, homeless, semi feral, unwanted, stray, community, alley and street cats into loving homes. 

I hope you’ll find my videos entertaining, educational and emotive.

Please consider donating, to help me grow this channel. Thank you for your kind support.
